transcript: Nira: Thanks for making time today.
Milo: Of course. Have a good afternoon.
Nira: We could use the staged path, or perhaps keep the direct path.
Milo: Both are still options. We need more information before choosing.
Nira: Agreed, we will use the staged path.
Milo: I will prepare the migration checklist by Friday.
Nira: The checklist needs to be reviewed before launch.
Milo: We have not assigned an owner yet.
Nira: I will prepare the launch notes.
Milo: The timing is not set yet.
Nira: I recommend a staged launch.
Milo: I prefer a direct launch, but we have not resolved it.
Milo: No, we rejected that. We will keep validation required.
Nira: Could someone prepare a launch memo?
Milo: Let us leave that open until the plan is approved.
